about_the_game:
Passed Out -Arcade- is a time attack racing game, where you drive fast anti-gravity vehicles !!

Simple Gameplay, slide accross the tracks at high speed, enjoy the various environments, Deserts, Mountains and Mediterranean landscapes !

The game today includes 6 ships and 9 tracks

The game is in an early Alpha version.

What's to come ?

-Leaderboards

-More Tracks

-More Championships

-More Categories

-Enhanced Boost System

Thank you for checking out my game, and have fun trying out the vehicles and tracks !
